Name: Cana's Sam Portrait
Author: passavodiqui
Description:
Hi there!
I'm Italian, I understand little English, I translated online. This is my first creation and hopefully last Mod, I created this Mod for myself and with a lot of effort, because I'm not a modder. I made it because I love Sam and I was looking for him sweet but hard, but he was nowhere to be found, then I decided to put it online, if you like to enjoy it. Don't forget to back up your save first.
To install it you have to open the file with 7zip or winrar or whatever you prefer and put it in the mod folder.

Thanks to Pathoschild who corrected my mod that was wrong.
